coverage: All nineteen scenes in both original-en and modern-en, with the Induction and Epilogue: named cast, speaking and stage roles, the Gloucestershire and Eastcheap acquaintance named only in talk, and the classical, biblical and balladic figures of the play’s allusions.

entities.name: Sir John Falstaff
entities.body: An old knight of the Prince’s company, fat, penniless and quick.

snapshots.body: The old knight of the Prince’s company, banished from the new king’s presence.

entities.name: Prince Henry
entities.body: King Henry’s eldest son and heir, called Harry Monmouth.

snapshots.body: King Henry the Fourth’s heir, now king in his father’s place.

entities.name: King Henry the Fourth
entities.body: The King, worn down by rebellion and sickness.

entities.name: Justice Shallow
entities.body: A country justice of Gloucestershire, and Falstaff’s old acquaintance.

entities.name: The Lord Chief Justice
entities.body: The chief justice of the King’s Bench, who once committed the Prince.

entities.name: Mistress Quickly
entities.body: Hostess of the Boar’s Head tavern in Eastcheap.

entities.name: Doll Tearsheet
entities.body: A woman of the Boar’s Head, and Falstaff’s companion.

entities.name: Pistol
entities.body: An ancient in Falstaff’s following, given to fustian and quarrels.

entities.name: Bardolph
entities.body: A corporal in Falstaff’s following, known by his red face.

entities.name: Poins
entities.body: A companion of the Prince’s.

entities.name: Prince John of Lancaster
entities.body: King Henry’s second son, who commands against the rebels.

snapshots.body: King Henry’s second son, who has taken the rebel leaders at Gaultree by a promise.

entities.name: The Archbishop of York
entities.body: Richard Scroop, the churchman leading the rebellion.

entities.name: The Earl of Warwick
entities.body: A nobleman of the King’s council, of the Nevil family.

entities.name: The Earl of Westmoreland
entities.body: A nobleman who commands for the King.

entities.name: Lord Bardolph
entities.body: A nobleman of the rebel party; not the corporal of the same name.

entities.name: The Earl of Northumberland
entities.body: Hotspur’s father, and the rebellion’s absent leader.

snapshots.body: Hotspur’s father, persuaded by his wife and Hotspur’s widow to leave the rebellion for Scotland.

entities.name: The Page
entities.body: The boy Prince Henry gave Falstaff for a page.

entities.name: Lord Mowbray
entities.body: The Earl Marshal, one of the rebel lords.

entities.name: Lord Hastings
entities.body: One of the rebel lords.

entities.name: Justice Silence
entities.body: A country justice, Shallow’s cousin.

entities.name: Thomas, Duke of Clarence
entities.body: King Henry’s son, brother to the Prince.

entities.name: Davy
entities.body: Justice Shallow’s servant, who runs his household and his farm.

entities.name: Humphrey, Duke of Gloucester
entities.body: King Henry’s youngest son.

entities.name: Fang
entities.body: A sergeant employed to arrest Falstaff.

entities.name: Francis Feeble
entities.body: A woman’s tailor, pressed for the wars.

entities.name: Morton
entities.body: The gentleman who brings Northumberland the true news from Shrewsbury.

entities.name: Ralph Mouldy
entities.body: A Gloucestershire man pressed for the wars, and bought out again.

entities.name: Peter Bullcalf
entities.body: A Gloucestershire man pressed for the wars, and bought out again.

entities.name: Sir John Colevile
entities.body: A rebel knight who yields himself to Falstaff.

entities.name: Gower
entities.body: A gentleman who brings the Chief Justice his news.

entities.name: Snare
entities.body: A sergeant employed with Fang to arrest Falstaff.

entities.name: Simon Shadow
entities.body: A Gloucestershire man pressed for the wars.

entities.name: Thomas Wart
entities.body: A Gloucestershire man pressed for the wars.

entities.name: Travers
entities.body: Northumberland’s servant, who brings him the first false report.

entities.name: Lady Northumberland
entities.body: Northumberland’s wife.

entities.name: Lady Percy
entities.body: Hotspur’s widow, and Northumberland’s daughter-in-law.

entities.name: The Earl of Surrey
entities.body: A nobleman attending the King.

entities.name: Harcourt
entities.body: A gentleman who brings the King news of the northern defeat.

entities.name: Sir John Blunt
entities.body: A knight in Prince John’s company.

entities.name: Rumour
entities.body: The figure painted full of tongues who speaks the Induction.

entities.name: The Epilogue
entities.body: The speaker who kneels for the audience’s favour at the end.

entities.name: The servant
entities.body: The Chief Justice’s servant, sent after Falstaff.

entities.name: The First Drawer
entities.body: A drawer at the Boar’s Head.

entities.name: The Second Drawer
entities.body: A drawer at the Boar’s Head.

entities.name: The First Beadle
entities.body: The beadle who carries off the Hostess and Doll.

entities.name: The Porter
entities.body: Northumberland’s porter.

entities.name: The First Groom
entities.body: A groom strewing rushes for the coronation.

entities.name: The Second Groom
entities.body: A groom strewing rushes for the coronation.

entities.name: The messenger
entities.body: A messenger bringing word to the rebel camp.

entities.name: Sneak
entities.body: The leader of the musicians the Hostess sends for.

entities.name: The lords
entities.body: The lords of the King’s council and the rebel party.

entities.name: The officers
entities.body: The officers who attend the Chief Justice and the arrests.

entities.name: The beadles
entities.body: The beadles who take the Hostess and Doll into custody.

entities.name: The drawers
entities.body: The drawers at the Boar’s Head.

entities.name: The grooms
entities.body: The grooms strewing rushes for the coronation.

entities.name: The justices
entities.body: Shallow and Silence together on the Gloucestershire bench.

entities.name: Harry Percy, called Hotspur
entities.body: Northumberland’s son, killed at Shrewsbury before this play opens.

entities.name: John of Gaunt
entities.body: King Henry’s father, whom Shallow claims to have known.

entities.name: King Edward the Third
entities.body: The King’s great-grandfather.

entities.name: King Richard the Second
entities.body: The king Henry the Fourth deposed, whose blood the rebels invoke.

entities.name: Owen Glendower
entities.body: The Welsh leader whose death is reported to the King.

entities.name: The Earl of Douglas
entities.body: The Scottish lord who fought at Shrewsbury.

entities.name: Thomas Mowbray, Duke of Norfolk
entities.body: The old Duke, whom Falstaff served as page; the rebel Mowbray’s father.

entities.name: Sir John Umfrevile
entities.body: A knight who turned Travers back on the road with news.

entities.name: Katharine of France
entities.body: The French princess the Epilogue promises for the next play.

entities.name: Oldcastle
entities.body: The martyr the Epilogue distinguishes from Falstaff.

entities.name: Jane Nightwork
entities.body: A woman of Shallow’s young days, remembered at Gloucestershire.

entities.name: Robin Nightwork
entities.body: Jane Nightwork’s son.

entities.name: Ellen
entities.body: Silence’s daughter and Shallow’s god-daughter.

entities.name: William
entities.body: Shallow’s cousin, now at Oxford.

entities.name: William cook
entities.body: The cook of Shallow’s household.

entities.name: William Visor of Woncot
entities.body: A man of Shallow’s country whom Davy asks him to favour.

entities.name: Clement Perkes
entities.body: A man of the hill, William Visor’s adversary.

entities.name: John Doit
entities.body: A Staffordshire man of Shallow’s young days.

entities.name: George Barnes
entities.body: A man of Shallow’s young days.

entities.name: Francis Pickbone
entities.body: A man of Shallow’s young days.

entities.name: Will Squele
entities.body: A Cotswold man of Shallow’s young days.

entities.name: Sampson Stockfish
entities.body: A fruiterer Shallow fought behind Gray’s Inn.

entities.name: Scoggin
entities.body: A man whose head Shallow claims to have broken.

entities.name: Master Surecard
entities.body: The name Falstaff gives Silence on meeting him.

entities.name: Puff of Barson
entities.body: A man Pistol boasts of outfacing.

entities.name: Master Smooth
entities.body: A silkman the Hostess says Falstaff owes money to.

entities.name: Master Dommelton
entities.body: The draper who would not take Bardolph’s security.

entities.name: Goodwife Keech
entities.body: The butcher’s wife who came to borrow vinegar.

entities.name: Master Tisick
entities.body: The deputy who warned the Hostess about her guests.

entities.name: Robin Hood
entities.body: The outlaw of the ballad Silence sings.

entities.name: Scarlet
entities.body: One of Robin Hood’s men in the same ballad.

entities.name: Little John
entities.body: Another of Robin Hood’s men in the same ballad.

entities.name: King Arthur
entities.body: The king of the romances; Falstaff calls the Page his Dagonet.

entities.name: Dagonet
entities.body: King Arthur’s fool in the romances.

entities.name: King Cophetua
entities.body: The king of the ballad Pistol quotes.

entities.name: Calipolis
entities.body: The queen of an old play Pistol quotes at Doll.

entities.name: Hiren
entities.body: The name Pistol gives his sword, out of an old play.

entities.name: Amurath
entities.body: The Turkish sultan whose succession was a massacre of brothers.

entities.name: Achitophel
entities.body: The false counsellor of the Bible, in Pistol’s abuse.

entities.name: Cain
entities.body: The first murderer, in Falstaff’s abuse of the Page.

entities.name: Japhet
entities.body: Noah’s son, whom all men claim descent from.

entities.name: Job
entities.body: The patient sufferer of the Bible.

entities.name: The Psalmist
entities.body: The writer of the psalms, cited by Shallow.

entities.name: Jesus
entities.body: Named in the oaths of the play.

entities.name: Saint George
entities.body: The saint whose field in London Shallow remembers.

entities.name: Lucifer
entities.body: The chief of the fallen angels.

entities.name: Galen
entities.body: The Greek physician, cited by Falstaff on his own diseases.

entities.name: Caesar
entities.body: The Roman conqueror, in Pistol’s and Falstaff’s flourishes.

entities.name: Agamemnon
entities.body: The Greek commander at Troy.

entities.name: Hector
entities.body: The great defender of Troy.

entities.name: Helen
entities.body: The woman of Troy, in Pistol’s rant.

entities.name: Priam
entities.body: The king of Troy, who heard his city burning before the news came.

entities.name: Althaea
entities.body: The mother of Greek myth whose burning brand ended her son’s life.

entities.name: Atropos
entities.body: The fate who cuts the thread of life.

entities.name: Alecto
entities.body: One of the Furies, in Pistol’s rant.

entities.name: Cerberus
entities.body: The dog of the underworld.

entities.name: Erebus
entities.body: The darkness of the underworld.

entities.name: Pluto
entities.body: The god of the underworld.

entities.name: Neptune
entities.body: The god of the sea.

entities.name: Jove
entities.body: The king of the gods.

entities.name: Saturn
entities.body: The cold planet-god, paired with Venus in the Prince’s joke.

entities.name: Venus
entities.body: The planet and goddess of love.

entities.name: Hydra
entities.body: The many-headed monster.

entities.name: The Furies
entities.body: The avenging spirits Pistol calls on.

entities.name: The Vice
entities.body: The mischief-maker of the old morality plays.
